title: Korean NHI-reported physicians, institutions and care, 2023–2024
status: Extracted empirical aggregates; no 2026 nowcast or joint physician microdata reconstruction.

license.note: Marking directly observed on the alternate HIRA 2024 yearbook post. NHIS attachment page and the first HIRA post carry no observed work-specific marking. 2023 file-specific marking was not verified. Raw files remain git-ignored; processed file contains selected factual aggregates with attribution, not report facsimiles.

revision_status.note: NHIS current PDF and workbooks were acquired directly. HIRA lists a corrected PDF and corrigendum; its download helper repeatedly timed out, so equality to that corrected attachment has not been established. Acquired NHIS PDF matches the SMHDB mirror byte-for-byte.

definitions.workforce_reference: Year-end personnel reported by NHI-claiming providers to HIRA; physicians use an exclusive-contract (전속) criterion. Persons, not FTE, licensed totals, all employed physicians, or owners.
definitions.physicians: 의사 only, excluding dentists and Korean medicine physicians; includes general practitioners, interns, residents and specialists.
definitions.institution_reference: Year-end NHI provider registrations, not all Medical Service Act registrations. Provider types remain separate legal/reporting categories.
definitions.region: Provider location; institution × region is observed. Physician region and institution margins are separate tables, not a joint distribution.
definitions.individual_establishment: 개인 in an institution registration table; counts institutions, not owner physicians or self-employed clinicians.
definitions.care_reference: NHIS Table III-4, service-date 2024 care, reflecting payments January 2024 through April 2025. NHI insured service users; not all medical spending.
definitions.visit_days: 입내원일수: patient visit-days or inpatient bed-days recorded in claims. Not unique patients, completed cases or quality-adjusted care.
definitions.reimbursed_days: 요양급여일수: includes in-facility medication days; an overlapping visit/medication day counts once.
definitions.patients: Within-category unique patients. Patients can overlap across settings and provider types; do not sum them to a national unique-patient count.
definitions.medical_expenses_thousand_krw: Insurer payment plus statutory patient copayment for covered care, in KRW 1,000; not physician income or net institution profit. Workbook precision retained as decimal strings.
definitions.insurer_benefits_thousand_krw: NHIS share of covered expenses, in KRW 1,000; workbook precision retained as decimal strings.
definitions.zeros: Source workbook numeric zeros are retained. The PDF commonly displays them as a dash.
